product_metadata.title: Low Humidity Mini Dehumidfier, 40oz (1200ml) Capacity, 1200 cubic feet(215 sq ft) Portable and Quiet Small Dehumidifier for Bedroom, Barthroom, Basements, Closet, RVs
features: "tiny but mighty" - Effectively maintains optimum indoor humidity between 30 - 50%. Electric dehumidifier with 40oz capacity tank remove 8oz(250ml) of water/day in a humid environment of 80℉. Optimum use of space up to 1200 cubic feet (215 sq ft). Working for improve air quality and keep a health living environment for you.

Portable and Small Design - It is easy move from room to room when you need it. Lightweight (3.3 lbs) can be lifted with one hand. Mini size (5.7x11x7.8inch) is effective for cupboard, office, hallway, child bedroom or laundry —essentially any small space where you want to reduce humidity.

low noise - It is built-in the latest Semiconductor Cooling Technology operates without a compressor. Advantages have a maximum noise level of no more than 35 db. They are not disruptive to your daily life, and run quietly and efficiently in the background without most people even noticing.

Energy saving and ECO-friendly - Electric dehumidifiers are energy efficient saving with a power only 25W/hour it consumes using only 0.6kW of electricity after running for 24 hours. The dehumidifier more environmentally friendly and lasts longer than traditional chemical absorbents.

One Touch Control and Auto Shut Off - The indicator light is blue for normal operation and red for stopping operation. The indicator light would turn red when the water tank needs draining. If the indicator light is red when the box is empty, the tank is not installed properly.
